caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic pitcher with an oval base, wide body, and narrow neck, featuring a pronounced spout on one side and a curved handle on the opposite side. The pitcher is rendered in shades of brown and beige, with subtle variations in color suggesting a glazed surface and reflections of light. The handle and rim are slightly darker, while areas on the body show lighter patches, indicating highlights. The background is a uniform, pale beige color, creating no distinction from the surface on which the pitcher sits. The artist's signature appears in the lower right corner of the image.
title: Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
